sources.citation: RAVEL authored premises and conventions; license: Apache-2.0. External primary references are locator-only in each registry row.

nodes.statement: A reinterpretation needs the observable definition, selection and fiducial domain, rate conventions, correlations and statistical model used for the claimed quantity. A public histogram alone does not supply a likelihood or detector response.
nodes.applicability: Review this convention in the stated process, observable, phase-space domain and perturbative order; retrieval does not establish applicability.

evidence.locator: RAVEL authored convention conv:published-information; primary references: arXiv:1203.2489, recommendations for analysis information; arXiv:2003.07868, measurements, likelihoods and efficiencies

obligations.description: Locate primary selections, efficiencies, likelihoods and covariance; retain missing inputs and scope limits explicitly.

nodes.statement: An unfolded measurement inherits response and regularization assumptions from its reference model. A new resonance or altered event composition can change migrations; agreement with the tabulated bins does not validate those response assumptions.
nodes.applicability: Review this convention in the stated process, observable, phase-space domain and perturbative order; retrieval does not establish applicability.

evidence.locator: RAVEL authored convention conv:unfolding; primary references: arXiv:2003.07868, measurements, likelihoods and efficiencies

obligations.description: Find closure and stress tests for the published unfolding and compare the requested model with their tested domain.

nodes.statement: If a supplied full model includes a Standard Model component, adding it to the same Standard Model reference double counts that component. Form the model-minus-reference contribution using the same fiducial definitions and retain correlations from shared events and shared nuisance sources.
nodes.applicability: Review this convention in the stated process, observable, phase-space domain and perturbative order; retrieval does not establish applicability.

evidence.locator: RAVEL authored convention conv:reference-subtraction; primary references: arXiv:2003.07868, measurements, likelihoods and efficiencies; Phys. Rev. D 110, 030001; review Kinematics, phase space and cross sections

obligations.description: Identify exactly which reference was subtracted and match units, bins, cuts and perturbative order; account for shared uncertainty once.
